hero.title: My Lovable Job Application
hero.description: Tech-savvy, design-minded, and driven by creativity — I love bringing ideas to life in ways that empower people. I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to your Customer Success team, especially in the Support Specialist role. Thanks for stopping by and taking the time to explore my digital resume.

about.title: Your Next Customer Experience Champion 🏆
about.description: Native Swedish, fluent in English, and remote-ready with a pro home office. Based near Stockholm and familiar with Lovable's workspace in Waterfront Building. Open to full- or part-time — excited to join Lovable's next chapter!
about.contentParagraph1: I get tech, but more importantly - I get people! Having built SaaS platforms myself with over 100,000+ users, I understand both the technical challenges and the human frustration when things don't work.
about.contentParagraph2: That's where magic happens: turning complex challenges into simple solutions!
about.contentParagraph3: When I'm not empowering users to succeed, you'll find me building things with my hands (amateur carpenter at heart!) or chasing after my three kids with my wonderful wife. Same attention to detail, different tools!
about.contentParagraph3Mobile: When I'm not empowering users to succeed, you'll find me building things with my hands (amateur carpenter at heart!) or chasing after my three kids with my wonderful wife. Same attention to detail, different tools!

skills.title: My Customer Success Expertise 💎
skills.description: The perfect blend of technical expertise and people skills to make users and customers delighted!

tools.title: Tech Stack & Tools 🛠️
tools.description: Comfortable with the tools that make great support happen! Always curious and love exploring new trending tools!

experience.title: My Journey to Customer Experience Excellence 🌟
experience.titleMobile: My Journey to Customer Experience Excellence
experience.description: From university experiments to building platforms used by 100,000+ people — every step has fueled my passion for thoughtful design, user-focused development, and the powerful possibilities of AI.

items.title: AI Whisperer & Prompt Engineering Enthusiast
items.description: Deeply fascinated by prompt engineering and becoming fluent in 'AI language' - because the future of great support will blend human empathy with AI superpowers. I speak both human and machine! 🤖

items.title: Tech Entrepreneur & SaaS Builder
items.description: Built and operated multiple SaaS platforms serving 100,000+ users across various industries, mostly within Prop Tech. Deep hands-on experience with user acquisition, retention, support challenges, and scaling customer success operations. I've lived through every stage - from first user to scale - and understand what makes customers stick around! 🚀

items.title: Design & Customer Experience Advocate
items.description: Passionate about great design and smooth user experiences. I spot what works, what doesn't, and most importantly - I care about making it better. Your users deserve thoughtful, well-crafted experiences! ✨

items.title: Stockholm Office Veteran
items.description: Had my own office in the same Waterfront building where Lovable Stockholm is located. I know the coffee spots, the vibe, and what makes that workspace special. Remote-ready with a great home office setup! ☕

items.title: University Explorer
items.description: Studied IT, Marketing, and Economics at university - education taught me how to learn and think critically, which is invaluable! 📚 But honestly, the real magic happened when I started building actual projects and solving real problems in the wild. That's where everything clicked! 🛠️

whySupport.title: Customer + Daniel = Success! ✨
whySupport.description: I've been on both sides - building tools AND desperately needing great support! I know what it feels like to be stuck, and I live for those aha! moments when everything clicks. Let me help your users discover the joy of effortless building - especially in the Support Specialist role!

contact.title: Let's Make Customer Success Lovable Together!
contact.titleMobile: Let's Make Customer Success Lovable Together!
contact.description: I'd love to chat about joining the Lovable team! Whether it's customer success, support, or any role focused on user experience, I'm genuinely excited about the opportunity to bring my passion for customer satisfaction to the table. Let's connect and explore how we could work together!
